Consult a renal pathology specialist.
map.光镜近正常+免疫阴性+足突消失→微小病变，儿童激素敏感。: Light microscopy near normal + immunofluorescence negative + foot process effacement → minimal change disease, steroid-sensitive in children.

map.光镜定位、免疫定抗原、电镜看沉积部位，三者互补。: Light microscopy locates, immunofluorescence identifies the antigen, electron microscopy shows the deposition site; the three are complementary.
map.孤立肾、出血倾向、未控高血压慎用，权衡获益。: Use with caution in solitary kidney, bleeding tendency, uncontrolled hypertension; weigh the benefit.
